kpis.label: Measurements
kpis.description: Height / weight entries recorded for children under 18 (age at the time of measurement) in this period. Entries without a date of birth on the patient record are excluded because age cannot be established.

kpis.label: Children measured
kpis.description: Distinct children (under 18 at measurement) with at least one growth measurement in this period.

kpis.label: Growth-screen entries
kpis.description: Entries made on the growth-chart screen itself, the rest of the height and weight data comes from the consultation vitals drawer.

meta.note: Sample data: this demo renders anonymized mock data captured from a test environment.
